stem: In the \(xy\)-plane, the line through the points \((1, 2)\) and \((5, b)\) is perpendicular to the line through the points \((-2, 3)\) and \((2, 5)\). What is the value of \(b\)?
solution: The second line has slope \(\frac{5 - 3}{2 - (-2)} = \frac{1}{2}\), so the first line has slope \(-2\).
verify:
b = symbols('b')
m2 = Rational(5 - 3, 2 + 2)
sol = solve(Eq((b - 2)/4 * m2, -1), b)
assert sol == [-6]
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == sol
